summary.short: Joint MOFCOM and GAC announcement (4 April 2025) placing export controls on listed medium and heavy rare earth items: samarium, gadolinium, terbium, dysprosium, lutetium, scandium and yttrium. Exporters need MOFCOM licences and must flag controlled items at customs. Takes effect on publication.
summary.long: Joint announcement of the Ministry of Commerce and the General Administration of Customs, dated 4 April 2025, issued with State Council approval. It places export controls on listed items relating to seven medium and heavy rare earths: samarium, gadolinium, terbium, dysprosium, lutetium, scandium and yttrium. Covered items include metals, alloys and targets (control codes 1C902.a to 1C908.a), oxides and mixtures (.b), and compounds and mixtures (.c). Samarium-cobalt and terbium- and dysprosium-containing NdFeB permanent magnets are included. Explanatory notes state that alloys and targets include forms such as ingots, bars, powders and sheets, and that oxides and compounds include, but are not limited to, powder forms. Reference customs codes are listed for each item. Exporters must apply to the State Council commerce authority for a licence under the Export Control Law and the Dual-Use Items Export Control Regulations. Exporters must identify controlled items and state at customs declaration whether goods are controlled, giving the dual-use control code where applicable. If customs doubts declared information, it may query the declaration, and goods are not released during the query. The announcement takes effect on the date of publication and states that the dual-use items control list is updated at the same time.

notes: No article numbering; provisions are cited by Chinese item numbers (一、(一)、1.) and the 说明 notes. HS codes are marked 参考 (reference) only; controlled items are defined by the 1C902 to 1C908 numbers. The control list is updated concurrently but is not in this document. No end date, penalty or review clause is stated; the announcement takes effect on issue (自发布之日起正式实施). The issue date 2025年4月4日 is given as the dateline; no separate publication date is stated. Internal check: 说明 1 to 4 match the item sub-numbers (a.2, a.3, a.4 and b/c) in items 一 to 七; no inconsistency found.

The export controls are imposed under the announcement's operative decision.

thresholds.note: No numeric cutoff in the text changes legal treatment. Items are identified by item number (e.g., 1C902.a) and description. The numbers in the text are customs codes (参考海关商品编号) and item numbers, not thresholds.

enforcement.note: The announcement sets no fines, criminal penalties, licence revocation, clawback, suspension or blocking. It requires export operators to apply to MOFCOM for licences under the Export Control Law and the Dual-Use Items Export Control Regulations, which are cited but not included in the text. Customs may question declarations and hold goods during the query period (出口货物不予放行), but this is a procedural hold, not a penalty, so no enforcement row is recorded.
